import nanosurf
import time

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get all variables
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm area
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Scantime = 0.1  # 0.1 s time per line
scan.Lines = 32  # 32 lines per frame

# Set Z controller parameters (PID gains)
zcontrol.PGain = 100
zcontrol.IGain = 6000
zcontrol.DGain = 10

print(f"Scan configured:")
print(f"  Area: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm²")
print(f"  Time per line: {scan.Scantime} s")
print(f"  Lines per frame: {scan.Lines}")
print(f"  PID gains - P: {zcontrol.PGain}, I: {zcontrol.IGain}, D: {zcontrol.DGain}")

# Perform 3 sequential scans
for i in range(1, 4):
    print(f"\n=== Starting Scan {i} ===")
    
    # Start scan
    scan.StartFrameUp()
    
    # Wait for scan to complete
    scanning = scan.IsScanning
    while scanning:
        remaining = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
        print(f"Scan {i} in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining}")
        time.sleep(2)
        scanning = scan.IsScanning
    
    print(f"Scan {i} finished")
    time.sleep(1)  # Brief pause between scans

print("\nAll 3 scans completed successfully!")
del spm

import nanosurf
import time

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get all variables
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm² area
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Scantime = 0.1  # 0.1 s time per line
scan.Lines = 32  # 32 lines per frame

# Set Z controller parameters (PID gains)
zcontrol.PGain = 100
zcontrol.IGain = 6000
zcontrol.DGain = 10

print(f"Scan configured:")
print(f"  Image size: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm²")
print(f"  Time per line: {scan.Scantime} s")
print(f"  Lines per frame: {scan.Lines}")
print(f"  P gain: {zcontrol.PGain}")
print(f"  I gain: {zcontrol.IGain}")
print(f"  D gain: {zcontrol.DGain}")

# Start first scan
print("\nStarting Scan 1...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining}")
    time.sleep(1)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scan 1 finished")

del spm
